extracted_data.document_summary: This multicentre longitudinal GENFI study investigated the disease-modifying effects of common variants within TMEM106B (specifically the rs1990622 G allele dosage) on disease endophenotypes in genetic Frontotemporal Dementia (FTD) caused by GRN, C9orf72, or MAPT mutations. The study aimed to longitudinally examine the interactive effects between the TMEM106B-rs1990622 genetic polymorphism, FTD mutations, clinical status (presymptomatic/symptomatic), and time on brain imaging (grey matter volume), serum biomarkers (NfL), and cognitive/behavioural measures. Findings consistently demonstrate that the TMEM106B-rs1990622 G allele confers protective effects, likely in an additive manner, on multiple endophenotypes, including reduced grey matter atrophy, lower serum neurofilament light chain (NfL) levels, and better cognitive and behavioural outcomes, predominantly in GRN and C9orf72 mutation carriers, and reduces the risk of conversion to clinical FTD in GRN carriers.

treatment_details.therapy_type: Genetic modifier investigation; Observational longitudinal study
treatment_details.dose_specificity: This study is observational and investigates an intrinsic genetic factor, not an active therapeutic intervention. The 'dose' refers to the additive effects of the TMEM106B-rs1990622 G allele dosage (0, 1, or 2 G alleles), which was modeled as a continuous variable. The protective effects varied across genetic FTD groups (GRN, C9orf72, MAPT mutations), specific biomarkers, disease stage (presymptomatic vs. symptomatic), and over time (baseline vs. longitudinal). No deviations from an additive effect were observed (heterozygosity indicator P > 0.05), and no traditional dose-response comparisons for a therapeutic agent were reported.

analyzed_biomarkers.activity_type: Imaging Biomarker (Voxel-based analysis of grey matter volume)

measured_effect.magnitude_quantification: In C9orf72 presymptomatic carriers: less atrophy in the right occipital region at baseline and in the right calcarine cortex. In C9orf72 symptomatic carriers longitudinally: reduced atrophy rate (0.006 to 0.012 ΔpGM per G allele/year reduction) in putamen, caudate nucleus, insular cortex, fronto-temporal cortices, and cingulate cortex. In GRN presymptomatic carriers longitudinally: reduced atrophy rate (0.004 to 0.006 ΔpGM per G allele/year reduction) within the right temporal and occipital regions. In GRN symptomatic carriers longitudinally: reduced atrophy rate (0.013 to 0.02 ΔpGM per G allele/year reduction) in the right frontal cortex, insula, left anterior cingulate cortex, superior frontal gyrus, and bilateral putamen. In MAPT symptomatic carriers longitudinally: reduced atrophy rate in the right inferior frontal gyrus. Overall, reduced atrophy rate in the right frontal region observed in all three gene groups (strongest in GRN). In C9orf72 and GRN groups past EASO: Less atrophy over time compared to converter counterparts in left insular volume. Lower cortical volumes were associated with rs1990622 AA genotype compared to AG/GG in frontal (P=0.009), temporal (P=0.029), cingulate (P=0.014), and insular (P=0.018) lobes. Reduced grey matter volume of left-sided temporal brain regions (β = −88.8 μl per risk allele, P = 7.64 × 10−5) was associated with the rs1990622 A allele in a population-based study.

analyzed_biomarkers.core_biological_function: Reflects neurodegeneration, neuronal loss, and brain structural integrity. Indicator of brain atrophy and neuronal health.
analyzed_biomarkers.relevant_activity_context: Genetic Frontotemporal Dementia (C9orf72, GRN, MAPT mutations) in presymptomatic and symptomatic carriers, modified by TMEM106B-rs1990622 G allele dosage. Also observed in clinically diagnosed FTD cohort and population-based Rotterdam Study.
analyzed_biomarkers.performance_or_health_indicator: Indicates progression of neurodegeneration and brain structural health in FTD; reduced atrophy suggests a protective effect against disease progression and better preservation of brain tissue.

measured_effect.magnitude_quantification: In C9orf72 presymptomatic carriers: lower NfL levels at baseline; however, no difference over time. In GRN presymptomatic carriers longitudinally: lower serum NfL levels over time (β for slope per G allele: -3.10, 95% CI: -4.75, -1.39; P: 0.0003). In GRN symptomatic carriers: lower NfL levels at both baseline (β per G allele: -27.86, 95% CI: -37.44, -18.30; P: 2.53 × 10^-8) and over time (β for slope per G allele: -6.43, 95% CI: -10.43, -2.43; P: 0.002). Past EASO GRN group: Lower levels of serum NfL over time than converter counterparts. No effects on serum NfL were observed in MAPT carriers. Elevated blood levels with wide variability were generally observed in presymptomatic FTD mutation carriers, potentially predicting conversion to clinical FTD.

analyzed_biomarkers.core_biological_function: Biomarker of axonal damage, neuroaxonal injury, and neurodegeneration.
analyzed_biomarkers.relevant_activity_context: Genetic Frontotemporal Dementia (C9orf72, GRN, MAPT mutations) in presymptomatic and symptomatic carriers, modified by TMEM106B-rs1990622 G allele dosage.
analyzed_biomarkers.performance_or_health_indicator: Indicates neuroaxonal damage and disease progression in FTD; lower levels suggest reduced neurodegeneration, reduced axonal damage, and a protective effect. May predict short-term risk of conversion to clinical FTD.

measured_effect.magnitude_quantification: In GRN symptomatic carriers: better global cognitive performance at baseline (β per G allele: 2.16, 95% CI: 2.27, 5.61, corrected P: 2.59 × 10^-5). In C9orf72 symptomatic group longitudinally: stronger protective effect on overall cognitive functions. No effects on global cognitive measures were observed in MAPT carriers. The rs1990622 A allele was associated with greater decline in MMSE score (β = 0.969, P = 0.001 in FTD; β = 0.123, P = 0.019 in Parkinson’s disease).

analyzed_biomarkers.core_biological_function: Reflects overall mental abilities including thinking, reasoning, memory, and problem-solving, indicative of brain health and neuronal integrity.
analyzed_biomarkers.relevant_activity_context: Genetic Frontotemporal Dementia (C9orf72, GRN, MAPT mutations) in presymptomatic and symptomatic carriers, modified by TMEM106B-rs1990622 G allele dosage.
analyzed_biomarkers.performance_or_health_indicator: Indicates cognitive and behavioral health; better scores or maintained function suggest a protective effect against FTD progression, improved functional outcomes, and better cognitive preservation.

measured_effect.magnitude_quantification: In C9orf72 presymptomatic carriers longitudinally: better executive functions (β for slope per G allele: 0.09, 95% CI: 0.03, 0.15, corrected P: 0.01).

analyzed_biomarkers.core_biological_function: Higher-order cognitive processes including planning, decision-making, working memory, and inhibition.
analyzed_biomarkers.relevant_activity_context: Association with TMEM106B-rs1990622 G allele dosage in presymptomatic C9orf72 carriers longitudinally.
analyzed_biomarkers.performance_or_health_indicator: Better scores indicate preserved executive function, which is critical for daily living and disease management in FTD.

measured_effect.magnitude_quantification: In C9orf72 presymptomatic carriers longitudinally: better language abilities (β for slope per G allele: 0.11, 95% CI: 0.04, 0.19, corrected P: 0.024).

analyzed_biomarkers.core_biological_function: Ability to comprehend, produce, and use language effectively.
analyzed_biomarkers.relevant_activity_context: Association with TMEM106B-rs1990622 G allele dosage in presymptomatic C9orf72 carriers longitudinally.
analyzed_biomarkers.performance_or_health_indicator: Better scores indicate preserved language abilities, which are significant for communication and often affected in FTD.

measured_effect.magnitude_quantification: In C9orf72 symptomatic group longitudinally: stronger protective effect on behavior. No protective effects observed in GRN groups. The symptomatic C9orf72 group was the only group demonstrating additive protective effects of rs1990622 G on behaviour longitudinally.

analyzed_biomarkers.core_biological_function: Reflects daily behavioral changes and symptoms, often a key indicator in neurodegenerative diseases; reflects social and emotional regulation, indicative of neuropsychiatric health.
analyzed_biomarkers.relevant_activity_context: Association with TMEM106B-rs1990622 G allele dosage in symptomatic C9orf72 carriers longitudinally.
analyzed_biomarkers.performance_or_health_indicator: Improved behavioral scores indicate a reduction in behavioral symptoms associated with FTD and better behavioral health.

measured_effect.magnitude_quantification: In GRN symptomatic carriers longitudinally: better attention/processing speed scores (β for slope per G allele: 0.28, 95% CI: 0.09, 0.46; corrected P: 0.02). The C9orf72 group also showed more generalized protective effects on cognition longitudinally, including these domains.

analyzed_biomarkers.core_biological_function: Ability to focus concentration and efficiently process information, components of cognitive function critical for daily activities.
analyzed_biomarkers.relevant_activity_context: Association with TMEM106B-rs1990622 G allele dosage in symptomatic GRN and C9orf72 carriers longitudinally.
analyzed_biomarkers.performance_or_health_indicator: Higher scores indicate better attention and processing speed, crucial cognitive functions often impacted in FTD, suggesting better cognitive preservation.

measured_effect.magnitude_quantification: No significant protective effects observed in any of the gene groups at baseline or over time.

analyzed_biomarkers.core_biological_function: Ability to encode, store, and retrieve information.
analyzed_biomarkers.relevant_activity_context: Secondary analysis of TMEM106B-rs1990622 G allele dosage in GENFI 2 subsample of FTD mutation carriers.
analyzed_biomarkers.performance_or_health_indicator: No observable impact on memory performance, suggesting TMEM106B-rs1990622 G allele does not protect memory in this context.

analyzed_biomarkers.biomarker_name: Risk of conversion to clinical FTD

measured_effect.magnitude_quantification: GRN-TMEM106B AG group: Significantly lower risk of conversion (HR: 0.22; 95% CI: 0.05, 0.98; P-value: 0.046) compared to GRN-TMEM106B AA. GRN-TMEM106B GG group: No converters over a mean follow-up of 4 years.

analyzed_biomarkers.core_biological_function: Measures the likelihood of disease progression from a presymptomatic to a symptomatic state.
analyzed_biomarkers.relevant_activity_context: Secondary survival analysis examining the association of rs1990622 G allele dosage with risk of conversion to clinical FTD in presymptomatic C9orf72, GRN, and MAPT carriers.
analyzed_biomarkers.performance_or_health_indicator: Lower hazard ratio indicates a reduced risk of disease onset, suggesting a protective effect of the G allele against FTD progression.

measured_effect.magnitude_quantification: P = 1.08 × 10−11; odds ratio (OR) = 0.61, 95% confidence interval (CI): 0.53–0.71; stronger effect in GRN mutation carriers. The protective effects are most pronounced in GRN mutation carriers. The study found additive effects, where the presence of one protective G allele confers some degree of protection. The frequency of rs1990622 GG individuals was 10% (n=3) in GRN symptomatic carriers compared to 22.2% (n=10) in symptomatic C9orf72 carriers.

analyzed_biomarkers.core_biological_function: Genetic risk factor for FTLD-TDP; modifies disease course and influences age of onset. Genetic modifier influencing lysosomal function and disease progression in neurodegenerative disorders.
analyzed_biomarkers.relevant_activity_context: FTLD-TDP (especially GRN group), C9orf72 repeat expansions, undifferentiated clinical FTD, healthy individuals, GRN carriers (for age of onset), FTD endophenotypes, MAPT mutations, healthy older adults.
analyzed_biomarkers.performance_or_health_indicator: Protection against FTLD-TDP; associated with delayed disease onset or milder course; associated with remaining asymptomatic throughout life or until a later age, particularly in GRN mutation carriers.

measured_effect.magnitude_quantification: Detrimental allele; associated with lower cortical volumes in frontal (P = 0.009), temporal (P = 0.029), cingulate (P = 0.014), and insular (P = 0.018) lobes (AA vs AG/GG genotype); reduced grey matter volume of left-sided temporal brain regions (β = −88.8 μl per risk allele, P = 7.64 × 10−5); greater decline in MMSE score (β = 0.969, P = 0.001 in FTD; β = 0.123, P = 0.019 in Parkinson’s disease). The TMEM106B risk allele was associated with lower volumes in left temporal regions in healthy older adults.

analyzed_biomarkers.core_biological_function: Genetic risk factor for FTLD-TDP; influences age of onset; associated with neurodegeneration and cognitive impairment.
analyzed_biomarkers.relevant_activity_context: Clinically diagnosed FTD cohort, population-based Rotterdam Study, persons with Parkinson’s disease, GRN carriers, healthy older adults.
analyzed_biomarkers.performance_or_health_indicator: Associated with increased risk of FTD, faster brain atrophy, and accelerated cognitive decline.

analyzed_biomarkers.measured_tissue_or_fluid: Neurons, glial and endothelial cells (for expression); assessed in symptomatic GRN mutation carriers
analyzed_biomarkers.activity_type: Gene Transcript (mRNA expression) and Protein Level

measured_effect.magnitude_quantification: Higher TMEM106B mRNA expression and protein levels in those with no protective TMEM106B G allele in symptomatic GRN mutation carriers.

analyzed_biomarkers.core_biological_function: Integral membrane glycoprotein predominantly located in endosomes and lysosomes, critical for clearance of cell debris including proteins. Involved in lysosomal formation, acidification, and transport.
analyzed_biomarkers.relevant_activity_context: No protective TMEM106B G allele in symptomatic GRN mutation carriers; upregulated or overexpressed TMEM106B.
analyzed_biomarkers.performance_or_health_indicator: Higher levels are associated with improper lysosomal formation, poor lysosomal acidification, attenuated lysosomal transport, and increased lysosomal stress, all linked to neurodegenerative disorders.

analyzed_biomarkers.measured_tissue_or_fluid: Not explicitly stated for accumulation, but inferred from 'double knock-out models of Tmem106b − / − and Grn − / − mice' and 'cellular model for TDP-43' (implying neuronal/cellular tissue).

measured_effect.magnitude_quantification: Disease pathology was exacerbated along with accumulation of phosphorylated TDP-43 in an age-dependent manner in double knock-out models of Tmem106b − / − and Grn − / − mice. An increase in TDP-43 cytoplasmic aggregates was reported in Tmem106b knock-out mice in a cellular model for TDP-43.

analyzed_biomarkers.core_biological_function: TDP-43 is a nuclear protein involved in RNA metabolism; its mislocalization or aggregation is a hallmark of several neurodegenerative diseases.
analyzed_biomarkers.relevant_activity_context: Double knock-out models of Tmem106b − / − and Grn − / − mice; Tmem106b knock-out mice in a cellular model; GRN haploinsufficiency.
analyzed_biomarkers.performance_or_health_indicator: Serves as a marker of exacerbated disease pathology and neurodegeneration, particularly in contexts of Tmem106b and Grn deficiencies.
